definitions.explanation: A Buddhist ceremony held to pray for the souls of deceased family members, typically conducted on specific anniversaries of death.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧、⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{法事|ほうじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a memorial service for my grandfather next week.

examples.japanese: {法事|ほうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ために→ために：28332_tameni⟧⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: The relatives gathered for the Buddhist memorial service.

examples.japanese: ⟦{七回忌|ななかいき}→七回忌：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{法事|ほうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: We will hold a memorial service on the seventh anniversary of death.

notes:
TIMING:
{法事|ほうじ} is held on specific anniversaries after a person's death:
- ⟦{初七日|しょなのか}→初七日：06016_shonanoka⟧: 7th day
- ⟦{四十九日|しじゅうくにち}→四十九日：06017_shijuukunichi⟧: 49th day (important transition)
- ⟦{一周忌|いっしゅうき}→一周忌：06018_isshuuki⟧: 1st anniversary
- ⟦{三回忌|さんかいき}→三回忌：06019_sankaiki⟧: 2nd anniversary (3rd year by Japanese count)
- ⟦{七回忌|ななかいき}→七回忌：noentry⟧, ⟦{十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき}→十三回忌：28964_juusankaiki⟧, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {法事|ほうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to hold a memorial service
- {法事|ほうじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to attend a memorial service
- {法事|ほうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧: preparation for memorial service

RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧: more formal term for Buddhist memorial service
- ⟦{葬式|そうしき}→葬式：04389_soushiki⟧: funeral
- ⟦{命日|めいにち}→命日：17539_meinichi⟧: death anniversary
